name: train_parallel
description: Dispatch marker for the parallel bot training of .github/workflows/riftlab.yml (request=lab/specs/train_parallel.json, chain=N iterations). One iteration per workflow run: 1600 self-play games on 8 machines, the candidate trained on the last 3 iterations, then 6 mirror gate blocks, 5 panel matchups and 3 yardsticks on 14 machines; adopted at 55% (or an SPRT win) with at least 45% on the panel.
